coder_notes: Phase 0/2 registered as EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). MTAP deletion is required for the Phase 2 arms (title also says MTAP-deleted tumors) but is not in the formal inclusion criteria and is determined on resected tissue; coded enrichment for both registered arms; could alternatively be eligibility (same primary outcome). SDMA PD response (>=50% decrease or H-score <=70) also gates entry to Phase 2 arms; coded as pharmacodynamic. Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but Arm B receives standard RT+TMZ per description; listed as soc_backbone in Arm B only. Exploratory liquid biopsy (CTC/cfDNA) not listed as a specific biomarker.
